data.text: Research campaign started for question: Investigate empirical and theoretical determinants of critical temperature (Tc) across 21,263 materials in the UCI Superconductivity dataset. Test causal scaling laws between valence electron density, Debye frequency approximations, atomic mass variance, and transition temperature.

tasks.description: FALSIFICATION TASK 1 (Sign-Crossing Attack): Using code_executor on ./data/superconduct_data/train.csv merged with unique_m.csv. HARDENED ALIGNMENT PROTOCOL (per critique): (i) assert both files have identical row counts (21263); (ii) verify alignment by checking that the 81 feature columns in unique_m.csv match train.csv feature columns element-wise within tolerance 1e-9 on a random sample of 500 rows AND on 10 deterministic rows (first, last, and 8 evenly spaced); (iii) only after both checks pass, construct integer join key 'row_id' = 0..21262 on both frames and merge on row_id; (iv) assert zero NaNs post-merge; ABORT with explicit error if any check fails. Refit the hierarchical model log(Tc) = beta1 + beta2*log(Debye_proxy) + beta3*sigma_M + beta4*log(Debye_proxy)*sigma_M + epsilon where Debye_proxy = sqrt(n_valence/mean_atomic_mass). Bootstrap 2000 resamples of beta3 and implied sigma_star = -beta2/beta3. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: (A) 95% CI of sigma_star excludes 2.0 amu AND excludes 0 -> hypothesis crossing claim FALSIFIED; (B) CI contains 2.0 amu -> hypothesis SURVIVES this attack. Report bootstrap distribution, convergence diagnostics, and whether sigma_star sign matches the hypothesis-predicted +2.0 amu. fact_checker_agent must verify the reported beta2, beta3, sigma_star point estimates and CI bounds against the raw merged data before the verdict is finalized.
tasks.expected_output: JSON with beta2, beta3, sigma_star point estimates, 2000-sample bootstrap CIs, alignment-verification log (row counts, feature-equality check results, NaN count), verdict flag {FALSIFIED, SURVIVES}, fact_checker verification status, and histogram path of sigma_star bootstrap distribution.

tasks.description: CONFOUNDER ATTACK (Orthogonal vector: collinearity): sigma_M is mechanically correlated with mean atomic mass and element count in the UCI feature set. Using statsmodels OLS with mandatory VIF and Durbin-Watson diagnostics, regress log(Tc) on (a) full model with sigma_M, (b) reduced model replacing sigma_M with mean_atomic_mass and number_of_elements only. Compare adjusted R-squared, AIC, and partial F-test for sigma_M's incremental contribution. Also compute Spearman correlation between sigma_M and mean_atomic_mass. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: (A) partial F p > 0.01 AND VIF(sigma_M) > 5 -> beta3 attenuation is a confound artifact, hypothesis mechanism FALSIFIED; (B) partial F p < 0.01 AND VIF(sigma_M) <= 5 -> sigma_M carries independent signal, hypothesis SURVIVES; (C) mixed case (p <= 0.01 XOR VIF <= 5) -> verdict INDETERMINATE, escalate to task_1_4 placebo result as tiebreaker. fact_checker_agent must verify the VIF table, partial F p-value, AIC values, and Spearman rho against the raw data before the verdict is finalized.
tasks.expected_output: VIF table, partial F-test p-value, AIC comparison, Spearman rho(sigma_M, mean_mass), verdict flag {FALSIFIED, SURVIVES, INDETERMINATE}, fact_checker verification status.

tasks.description: DATA-INTEGRITY ATTACK (Orthogonal vector: leakage/duplication): The UCI superconduct train.csv contains near-duplicate materials (same formula, different entries) which inflate Welch t and permutation significance. Using code_executor: (1) deduplicate by the 81 feature columns, count exact and near-duplicates (L2 distance < 1e-6); (2) group-split (GroupKFold by unique_m formula string) and refit beta2/beta3 on deduplicated data; (3) recompute Welch t and Cohen's d for ordered vs disordered groups. fact_checker_agent must verify the reported duplicate fraction, deduplicated n, and recomputed Welch t / Cohen's d against the raw data before the verdict is finalized. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: (A) duplicate fraction > 20% AND group-split beta3 CI includes 0 -> prior effect was leakage-inflated, hypothesis FALSIFIED; (B) beta3 remains significant (p < 0.01) on deduplicated group-split data -> hypothesis SURVIVES; (C) duplicate fraction <= 20% AND beta3 CI includes 0 -> verdict INDETERMINATE (effect absent but not leakage-explained), escalate to task_1_4.
tasks.expected_output: Duplicate fraction, deduplicated n, group-split beta3 estimate with CI, recomputed Welch t / Cohen's d, fact_checker verification status, verdict flag {FALSIFIED, SURVIVES, INDETERMINATE}.

tasks.description: PLACEBO ATTACK (Orthogonal vector: null calibration): The prior permutation p = 0.0002 coexisted with a high-false-positive warning. RUNTIME-HARDENED PROTOCOL (per critique): run a rigorous placebo test with code_executor using a REDUCED beta3-only refit (log(Tc) ~ beta1 + beta3*sigma_M + beta4*log(Debye_proxy)*sigma_M, no full hierarchical refit per permutation) to keep per-iteration cost low; 10,000 label permutations of sigma_M (shuffled across materials, seed 20240614), refitting beta3 each time to build an empirical null distribution. Additionally run a 'fake covariate' placebo using a random Gaussian column in place of sigma_M (single fit, not permuted). If wall-clock exceeds 40 minutes at the 2000-permutation checkpoint, fall back to 5000 permutations and record the reduction. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE OUTCOMES: (A) observed beta3 lies outside the 99.9th percentile of the empirical null AND fake-covariate beta3 is null -> attenuation signal is real, hypothesis SURVIVES; (B) fake covariate produces comparable |beta3| OR observed beta3 falls inside null body -> the beta3 attenuation is a statistical mirage, hypothesis FALSIFIED. fact_checker_agent must verify the null-distribution quantiles, observed percentile rank, and fake-covariate beta3 against the raw data before the verdict is finalized.
tasks.expected_output: Empirical null distribution stats (mean, sd, quantiles, actual permutation count used), observed beta3 percentile rank, fake-covariate beta3, runtime log, verdict flag, QQ plot path, fact_checker verification status.

tasks.description: GENERALIZATION ATTACK (Orthogonal vector: out-of-family holdout): The hypothesis claims materials with sigma_M < 2.0 amu and n_v in [4,6] e-/atom retain BCS scaling. Stratify the 21,263 materials by chemical family (using unique_m.csv element columns: cuprates, iron-based, low-Tc elemental/alloy, heavy-fermion candidates via Bi/Pb/U flags — acknowledged as a heuristic proxy for heavy-fermion class, acceptable for falsification purposes). Train the beta2_eff scaling law on 3 families, test log(Tc) prediction on the held-out family (RMSE vs family-mean baseline). EXHAUSTIVE OUTCOME SET (per critique, ties resolved by strict RMSE comparison with epsilon = 1e-12; a tie counts as NOT beating baseline): (A) scaling law beats baseline (RMSE_scaling < RMSE_baseline - epsilon) in <= 1 of 4 leave-one-family-out folds -> universal scaling law does not generalize, hypothesis FALSIFIED; (B) beats baseline in >= 3 of 4 folds -> hypothesis SURVIVES; (C) beats baseline in exactly 2 of 4 folds -> verdict INDETERMINATE, escalate to summarizer with per-family beta2_eff heterogeneity as secondary evidence. Report per-family beta2_eff and whether the [4,6] e-/atom retention band holds empirically. fact_checker_agent must verify the per-family beta2_eff table, fold RMSEs, and retention-band coverage against the raw data before the verdict is finalized.
tasks.expected_output: Per-family beta2_eff table, 4-fold leave-one-family-out RMSE comparison vs baseline with explicit win/loss/tie per fold, retention-band empirical coverage, verdict flag {FALSIFIED, SURVIVES, INDETERMINATE}, fact_checker verification status.

tasks.description: EVIDENCE CONSOLIDATION (per critique): summarizer_agent condenses the verdicts, key statistics, and fact_checker verification statuses from tasks 1_1 through 1_5 into a single consolidated falsification report for hypothesis a09f832e. Aggregation rule: hypothesis is FALSIFIED if >= 2 tasks return FALSIFIED; SURVIVES if >= 3 tasks return SURVIVES and none FALSIFIED; otherwise INDETERMINATE with explicit listing of which attacks were inconclusive and recommended next-cycle attacks. Any task whose fact_checker verification failed must be flagged and excluded from the vote with a re-run recommendation.
tasks.expected_output: Consolidated verdict {FALSIFIED, SURVIVES, INDETERMINATE}, per-task verdict table with fact_checker statuses, excluded-task flags, and next-cycle recommendations.

plan.rationale: PHASE 3 SIEGE (revised per critique v2): The active hypothesis (a09f832e) claims beta2_eff = beta2 + beta3*sigma_M crosses zero at sigma_M* ~ 2.0 amu, but the prior run reported sigma_star = -73.4 amu (CI [-270, -32]) — a direct internal contradiction. Five orthogonal attacks plus a mandatory summarizer consolidation task: (1) sign/crossing falsification with a hardened alignment protocol (feature-column equality verification before positional row_id join, abort-on-mismatch); (2) confounder attack via mass-variance collinearity with exhaustive three-way outcomes; (3) data-integrity attack with fact_checker verification; (4) runtime-hardened placebo test using reduced beta3-only refit with a 5000-permutation fallback; (5) out-of-family holdout generalization with exhaustive outcomes including the 2-of-4 tie case (ties count as losses, epsilon = 1e-12). fact_checker_agent is now attached to ALL numerical-claim tasks (1_1 through 1_5) per discipline requirement; summarizer_agent consolidates evidence in task_1_6. All attack tasks (1_1–1_5) remain dependency-free and parallelizable; task_1_6 depends on all five. exploration_ratio corrected to 0.0 (all tasks is_exploration=false; prior 0.9919 was a metric computation bug, now fixed). target_hypothesis_ids populated with a09f832e in all tasks to restore attack-to-hypothesis linkage.
